newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate rises to 51.54 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate rises to 51.54 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds rose to 51.54 percent from last week's 49 percent.
The central bank's offer of 1.35 trillion lei was heavily oversubscribed with five banks entering 1.53 trillion worth of bids at prices ranging between 51 to 52 percent.

Traders said they expected one-week prices to climb towards 45 percent on Friday from about 34 percent as some banks might chase money market funds following the oversubscription for the central bank's money.
On Thursday, the central bank raised by two percentage points to 51 percent the minimum permitted rate in a move to tighten its monetary policies to prop up a weaker leu currency.

The leu's retail rates dipped to some 5,000 to the dollar from about 4,500 last week and 3,500 in mid-October. Its interbank rates were by far firmer, now at 3,485/3,505. Auction results are on FXRP. -- Mirela Eremia, Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
